item.title: Getting Started With My Website :-)
item.author: dev@antomor.com (Antonio Morrone)
item.description:
Here in this post, I am going to explain why I am starting to write something on the internet and what I am going to share. I am well aware that there are many sites today describing almost everything, but these are some of the reasons that drive me at this point:

  1. to improve my language skills;
  2. to improve my online presence;
  3. to receive feedback (feedback is the key to growing);
  4. to share what I do (and how — I am also going to list some of my biggest mistakes).

And what about the content?
